_comment: UAT config baseline: the controller's shipped defaults (em_db.DEFAULT_DEVICE_CONFIG) with only these exceptions. Every UAT Echo follows the fleet (config_sections []). Add an exception only with a reason; tests/test_uat_baseline.py refuses one that names an unknown key or repeats the default.

site_keys._comment: Left as the site has them: secrets and addresses, never part of the baseline.
